slides.heading: Reception — Autumn 2, Week 2
slides.sub: New sounds taught directly, practised and applied in words, captions and the matching decodable book.

slides.heading: Mon
slides.objective: Learn the new sound "h" (/h/) and start reading and spelling words that use it.

slides.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="320" height="320" role="img" aria-label="hat" class="wp-icon wp-raster" data-picture="hat"><image href="data:image/png;base64," x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/></svg>

slides.mnemonic: Hazel the hedgehog puffs out a breathy 'h, h, h' every time she curls into a tight little ball.

character.name: Hazel
character.blurb: Hazel is a small sandy-brown hedgehog with one stray tuft of fur, who always puffs before she curls up to sleep.

slides.pronunciation_note: A soft breath out with no sound from the throat — just breathe out 'h', don't add 'huh'.
slides.formation_cue: Start at the top of a tall line. Pull straight down, go back up part of the way, then over in a hump and down. Finish on the line.
slides.formation_rhyme: Down, up and over a hump, down.
slides.action: Cup your hands loosely near your mouth and breathe out softly, 'h, h', like warming cold hands, the way Hazel puffs before curling up.
slides.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="320" height="320" role="img" aria-label="hat" class="wp-icon wp-raster" data-picture="hat"><image href="data:image/png;base64," x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/></svg>

slides.tip: You've only learned the short o so far, like in 'dog', but in 'no' the o says its long name 'oh' instead — two letters for one big, definite word.

slides.heading: Tue
slides.objective: Learn the new sound "b" (/b/) and start reading and spelling words that use it.

slides.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="320" height="320" role="img" aria-label="bag" class="wp-icon wp-raster" data-picture="bag"><image href="data:image/png;base64," x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/></svg>

slides.mnemonic: Bud the bee bumps gently against the flower petals — 'b, b, b' — before she lands.

character.name: Bud
character.blurb: Bud is a round, striped bee who always bumps softly against a flower bud before settling down to land.

slides.pronunciation_note: A short, bouncy sound with closed lips popping open — 'b', not 'buh'.
slides.formation_cue: Start at the top of a tall line. Pull straight down, go back up part of the way, then curve round to the right and back. Finish at the bottom of the line.
slides.formation_rhyme: Down the twig, loop round the nest.
slides.action: Tap your chest once, gently, with a closed fist, like Bud bumping a petal, saying 'b'.
slides.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="320" height="320" role="img" aria-label="bag" class="wp-icon wp-raster" data-picture="bag"><image href="data:image/png;base64," x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/></svg>

slides.dictation: A bug is in a cup.

slides.heading: Wed
slides.objective: Learn the new sound "f" (/f/) and start reading and spelling words that use it.

slides.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="320" height="320" role="img" aria-label="fan" class="wp-icon wp-raster" data-picture="fan"><image href="data:image/png;base64," x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/></svg>

slides.mnemonic: Fennel the feather floats down slowly, the air hissing softly past her — 'ffff'.

character.name: Fennel
character.blurb: Fennel is a slender, striped feather who loves to drift on the breeze, taking her time to reach the ground.

slides.pronunciation_note: A long, steady hiss made with the top teeth resting on the bottom lip — 'ffff', not 'fuh'.
slides.formation_cue: Start a little below the top, on the right. Curve up and over to the left, then pull straight down. Finish on the line. Lift, then draw a short line across at the top of the small letters, from left to right.
slides.formation_rhyme: Curl at the top, down, then cross.
slides.action: Rest your top teeth gently on your bottom lip and blow a long, slow 'ffff', like the breeze carrying Fennel down.
slides.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="320" height="320" role="img" aria-label="fan" class="wp-icon wp-raster" data-picture="fan"><image href="data:image/png;base64," x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/></svg>

slides.heading: Thu
slides.objective: Learn the new sound "ff" (/f/) and start reading and spelling words that use it.

slides.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="320" height="320" role="img" aria-label="cliff" class="wp-icon wp-raster" data-picture="cliff"><image href="data:image/png;base64," x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/></svg>

slides.mnemonic: Fluff the cloud puffs herself along the sky with one long, steady breath — 'ffff'.

character.name: Fluff
character.blurb: Fluff is a soft, wide cloud who moves across the sky by puffing herself gently forward.

slides.pronunciation_note: Two letters, one long sound — 'ff' says exactly the same steady hiss as single 'f'.
slides.formation_cue: Write 'f' twice, close together — two letters, one sound.
slides.action: Puff both cheeks out and blow one long, slow 'ffff', like Fluff drifting all the way across the sky.
slides.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="320" height="320" role="img" aria-label="cliff" class="wp-icon wp-raster" data-picture="cliff"><image href="data:image/png;base64," x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/></svg>

slides.heading: Fri
slides.objective: Revisit everything taught this week, read the matched decodable book, and check how securely it has been learned.
